RECORDS.description_main: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** A vulnerability was found in D-Link DIR-859 1.06B01. It has been rated as critical. Affected by this issue is some unknown functionality of the file /hedwig.cgi of the component HTTP POST Request Handler. The manipulation of the argument service with the input ../../../../htdocs/webinc/getcfg/DHCPS6.BRIDGE-1.xml leads to path traversal. The attack may be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. VDB-251666 is the identifier assigned to this vulnerability. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. NOTE: Vendor was contacted early and confirmed immediately that the product is end-of-life. It should be retired and replaced.

RECORDS.description_main: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** A vulnerability, which was classified as very critical, has been found in D-Link DNS-320L, DNS-325, DNS-327L and DNS-340L up to 20240403. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /cgi-bin/nas_sharing.cgi of the component HTTP GET Request Handler. The manipulation of the argument user with the input messagebus leads to hard-coded credentials. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The associated identifier of this vulnerability is VDB-259283. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. NOTE: Vendor was contacted early and confirmed immediately that the product is end-of-life. It should be retired and replaced.

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link路由器隐藏功能允许远程启用telnet服务
RECORDS.solution: 建议及时更新路由器固件，以避免已知的安全漏洞被利用。同时，应更改默认的管理员密码，确保只有授权用户可以访问telnet服务。
RECORDS.description_main: Certain models of D-Link wireless routers contain hidden functionality. By sending specific packets to the web service, the attacker can forcibly enable the telnet service and log in using hard-coded credentials. The telnet service enabled through this method can only be accessed from within the same local network as the device.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link部分无线路由器含有隐藏功能。通过向网络服务发送特定数据包，攻击者可以强行启用telnet服务，并使用预设的密码登录。通过这种方法启用的telnet服务只能从与设备相同的本地网络中访问。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Certain models of D-Link wireless routers contain hidden functionality. By sending specific packets to the web service, the attacker can forcibly enable the telnet service and log in using hard-coded credentials. The telnet service enabled through this method can only be accessed from within the same local network as the device."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link无线路由器存在WAN端口telnet服务漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 请参考设备制造商的安全更新指南或联系技术支持以获取修复方案。
RECORDS.description_main: Certain models of D-Link wireless routers have a hidden functionality where the telnet service is enabled when the WAN port is plugged in. Unauthorized remote attackers can log in and execute OS commands using hard-coded credentials.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link某些无线路由器的隐藏功能中，当WAN端口插入时，telnet服务会被启用。未经授权的远程攻击者可以使用硬编码的凭据登录并执行操作系统命令。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Certain models of D-Link wireless routers have a hidden functionality where the telnet service is enabled when the WAN port is plugged in. Unauthorized remote attackers can log in and execute OS commands using hard-coded credentials."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link某些无线路由器telnet服务用户输入验证不当漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 请参考官方安全公告或联系设备供应商以获取可能的修复方案。
RECORDS.description_main: Certain models of D-Link wireless routers do not properly validate user input in the telnet service, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to use hard-coded credentials to log into telnet and inject arbitrary OS commands, which can then be executed on the device.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 某些D-Link无线路由器的telnet服务没有正确验证用户输入，允许未经验证的远程攻击者使用硬编码的凭据登录telnet并注入任意操作系统命令，这些命令随后可以在设备上执行。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Certain models of D-Link wireless routers do not properly validate user input in the telnet service, allowing unauthenticated remote attackers to use hard-coded credentials to log into telnet and inject arbitrary OS commands, which can then be executed on the device."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: An uncontrolled resource consumption vulnerability exists in the `upload-link` endpoint of mintplex-labs/anything-llm. This vulnerability allows attackers to cause a denial of service (DOS) by shutting down the server through sending invalid upload requests. Specifically, the server can be made to shut down by sending an empty body with a 'Content-Length: 0' header or by sending a body with arbitrary content, such as 'asdasdasd', with a 'Content-Length: 9' header. The vulnerability is reproducible by users with at least a 'Manager' role, sending a crafted request to any workspace. This issue indicates that a previous fix was not effective in mitigating the vulnerability.

The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-21235.

RECORDS.description_main: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** A vulnerability classified as critical was found in D-Link DNS-120, DNR-202L, DNS-315L, DNS-320, DNS-320L, DNS-320LW, DNS-321, DNR-322L, DNS-323, DNS-325, DNS-326, DNS-327L, DNR-326, DNS-340L, DNS-343, DNS-345, DNS-726-4, DNS-1100-4, DNS-1200-05 and DNS-1550-04 up to 20240814. RECORDS.description_main: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, was found in D-Link DNS-120, DNR-202L, DNS-315L, DNS-320, DNS-320L, DNS-320LW, DNS-321, DNR-322L, DNS-323, DNS-325, DNS-326, DNS-327L, DNR-326, DNS-340L, DNS-343, DNS-345, DNS-726-4, DNS-1100-4, DNS-1200-05 and DNS-1550-04 up to 20240814. Affected is the function cgi_move_photo of the file /cgi-bin/photocenter_mgr.cgi. The manipulation of the argument photo_name leads to buffer overflow. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. NOTE: Vendor was contacted early and confirmed that the product is end-of-life. It should be retired and replaced.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link DNS-120系列路由器存在一个严重漏洞，该漏洞可能被远程利用。该漏洞影响的是/cgi-bin/photocenter_mgr.cgi文件中的cgi_move_photo功能，通过操纵photo_name参数可能导致缓冲区溢出。

RECORDS.description_main: A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, was found in D-Link DNS-120, DNR-202L, DNS-315L, DNS-320, DNS-320L, DNS-320LW, DNS-321, DNR-322L, DNS-323, DNS-325, DNS-326, DNS-327L, DNR-326, DNS-340L, DNS-343, DNS-345, DNS-726-4, DNS-1100-4, DNS-1200-05 and DNS-1550-04 up to 20240814. Affected is the function cgi_s3_modify of the file /cgi-bin/s3.cgi of the component HTTP POST Request Handler. The manipulation of the argument f_job_name leads to command injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. NOTE: Vendor was contacted early and confirmed that the product is end-of-life. It should be retired and replaced.

It has been classified as critical. This affects the function sprintf of the file /cgi-bin/hd_config.cgi. The manipulation of the argument f_mount leads to command injection. It is possible to initiate the attack remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. NOTE: Vendor was contacted early and confirmed that the product is end-of-life. It should be retired and replaced.

The function created at 0x17958 of /htdocs/cgibin will call sprintf without checking the length of strings in parameters given by HTTP header and can be controlled by users easily. The attackers can exploit the vulnerability to carry out arbitrary code by means of sending a specially constructed payload to port 49152.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link Wi-Fi路由器固件DIR-890L DIR890LA1_FW107b09.bin及之前的版本中，LAN端Web配置界面的Stack-based Buffer Overflow漏洞存在问题。/htdocs/cgibin中创建的函数位于0x17958处，将在没有检查由HTTP头参数给出的字符串长度的情况下调用sprintf，易受用户控制。攻击者可以利用此漏洞通过发送特别构造的负载到端口49152来执行任意代码。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"The LAN-side Web-Configuration Interface has Stack-based Buffer Overflow vulnerability in the D-Link Wi-Fi router firmware DIR-890L DIR890LA1_FW107b09.bin and previous versions. The function created at 0x17958 of /htdocs/cgibin will call sprintf without checking the length of strings in parameters given by HTTP header and can be controlled by users easily. The attackers can exploit the vulnerability to carry out arbitrary code by means of sending a specially constructed payload to port 49152."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary commands on affected installations of D-Link DIR-2150 4.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the xupnpd service, which listens on TCP port 4044 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-15905.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞可使网络邻近攻击者在受影响的 D-Link DIR-2150 4.0.1 路由器上执行任意命令。利用该漏洞无需身份验证。具体漏洞存在于默认情况下监听 TCP 端口 4044 的 xupnpd 服务中。问题在于在使用用户提供的字符串执行系统调用之前，缺乏对其进行适当验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在服务帐户的上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号: ZDI-CAN-15905。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary commands on affected installations of D-Link DIR-2150 4.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the xupnpd service, which listens on TCP port 4044 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-15905."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-2150 4.0.1 路由器存在远程代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: D-Link 已发布新版本来修复此漏洞。请访问其支持网站以获取最新版本的软件更新。同时，建议您更新到最新版本以提高安全性，并确保将路由器设置为自动更新以获得最新更新。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected D-Link DIR-2150 4.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the anweb service, which listens on TCP ports 80 and 443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-15727.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞存在于 DIR-2150 4.0.1 路由器的 anweb 服务中，攻击者可以在未经身份验证的情况下利用该漏洞执行任意的代码，攻击者可以在 TCP 端口 80 和 443 上监听并利用该漏洞。问题在于，该服务没有对用户提供的数据进行适当的验证，导致在将数据拷贝到固定长度的基于堆栈的缓冲区之前，长度没有得到验证。攻击者可以利用该漏洞在 root 的上下文中执行代码。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected D-Link DIR-2150 4.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the anweb service, which listens on TCP ports 80 and 443 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-15727."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-2150 4.0.1 路由器存在任意命令执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: D-Link 最新版固件已经修复了该漏洞。建议用户及时更新到最新版固件，或者关闭 xupnpd 服务，防止受到攻击。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary commands on affected installations of D-Link DIR-2150 4.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the xupnpd_generic.lua plugin for the xupnpd service, which listens on TCP port 4044 by default. When parsing the feed parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-15906.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞存在于 xupnpd 服务的 xupnpd_generic.lua 插件中，攻击者可以通过填写 feed 参数来执行任意系统命令。由于未对用户提供的字符串进行适当的验证，攻击者可以在服务账户的上下文中执行代码。攻击者无需认证即可利用此漏洞进行攻击。此漏洞编号为 ZDI-CAN-15906。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary commands on affected installations of D-Link DIR-2150 4.0.1 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the xupnpd_generic.lua plugin for the xupnpd service, which listens on TCP port 4044 by default. When parsing the feed parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the service account. Was ZDI-CAN-15906."}]}

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of Login requests to the web management portal. When parsing the HNAP_AUTH header, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-16139.

RECORDS.description_main:
In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: ethernet: stmmac: fix altr_tse_pcs function when using a fixed-link

When using a fixed-link, the altr_tse_pcs driver crashes
due to null-pointer dereference as no phy_device is provided to
tse_pcs_fix_mac_speed function. Fix this by adding a check for
phy_dev before calling the tse_pcs_fix_mac_speed() function.

Also clean up the tse_pcs_fix_mac_speed function a bit. There is
no need to check for splitter_base and sgmii_adapter_base
because the driver will fail if these 2 variables are not
derived from the device tree.
RECORDS.descriptions:
{"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"In the Linux kernel, the following vulnerability has been resolved:

net: ethernet: stmmac: fix altr_tse_pcs function when using a fixed-link

When using a fixed-link, the altr_tse_pcs driver crashes
due to null-pointer dereference as no phy_device is provided to
tse_pcs_fix_mac_speed function. Fix this by adding a check for
phy_dev before calling the tse_pcs_fix_mac_speed() function.

Also clean up the tse_pcs_fix_mac_speed function a bit. There is
no need to check for splitter_base and sgmii_adapter_base
because the driver will fail if these 2 variables are not
derived from the device tree."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-2640存在安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 厂商建议升级到更新的版本以纠正此问题。
RECORDS.description_main: Quagga Services on D-Link DIR-2640 less than or equal to version 1.11B02 are affected by an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to set the "message of the day" banner to any file on the system, allowing them to read all or some of the contents of those files. Such sensitive information as hashed credentials, hardcoded plaintext passwords for other services, configuration files, and private keys can be disclosed in this fashion. Improper handling of filenames that identify virtual resources, such as "/dev/urandom" allows an attacker to effect a denial of service attack against the command line interfaces of the Quagga services (zebra and ripd).
RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link DIR-2640的Quagga服务版本小于或等于1.11B02存在绝对路径遍历漏洞。攻击者可以利用此漏洞远程设置"每日信息"横幅到系统上的任何文件中，从而读取这些文件的全部或部分内容。攻击者可以通过此方式披露敏感信息，例如散列凭据、硬编码纯文本密码、配置文件和私钥。对于标识虚拟资源（例如"/dev/urandom"）的文件名的不正确处理可能会导致攻击者对Quagga服务（zebra和ripd）的命令行接口实施拒绝服务攻击。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Quagga Services on D-Link DIR-2640 less than or equal to version 1.11B02 are affected by an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to set the \"message of the day\" banner to any file on the system, allowing them to read all or some of the contents of those files. Such sensitive information as hashed credentials, hardcoded plaintext passwords for other services, configuration files, and private keys can be disclosed in this fashion. Improper handling of filenames that identify virtual resources, such as \"/dev/urandom\" allows an attacker to effect a denial of service attack against the command line interfaces of the Quagga services (zebra and ripd)."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-2640存在绝对路径遍历漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已发布具有修复此漏洞的版本。请更新到以下版本之一：1.11B05、1.20B06或1.21B01。 强烈建议用户尽快进行升级操作以确保设备的安全。
RECORDS.description_main: Quagga Services on D-Link DIR-2640 less than or equal to version 1.11B02 are affected by an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to set an arbitrary file on the router's filesystem as the log file used by either Quagga service (zebra or ripd). Subsequent log messages will be appended to the file, prefixed by a timestamp and some logging metadata. Remote code execution can be achieved by using this vulnerability to append to a shell script on the router's filesystem, and then awaiting or triggering the execution of that script. A remote, unauthenticated root shell can easily be obtained on the device in this fashion.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link DIR-2640版本1.11B02及以下版本的Quagga服务存在绝对路径遍历漏洞，攻击者可通过远程认证将路由器文件系统上的任意文件设置为Quagga服务（zebra或ripd）使用的日志文件。随后，日志消息将被追加到该文件中，前缀是时间戳和一些日志元数据。利用此漏洞，可以将内容附加到路由器文件系统上的shell脚本中，等待或触发该脚本的执行，从而实现远程代码执行。攻击者可以轻易地在该设备上获取未经身份验证的远程root shell。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Quagga Services on D-Link DIR-2640 less than or equal to version 1.11B02 are affected by an absolute path traversal vulnerability that allows a remote, authenticated attacker to set an arbitrary file on the router's filesystem as the log file used by either Quagga service (zebra or ripd). Subsequent log messages will be appended to the file, prefixed by a timestamp and some logging metadata. Remote code execution can be achieved by using this vulnerability to append to a shell script on the router's filesystem, and then awaiting or triggering the execution of that script. A remote, unauthenticated root shell can easily be obtained on the device in this fashion."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DAP-2020 v1.01rc001 Wi-Fi访问点漏洞

RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of D-Link DAP-2020 v1.01rc001 Wi-Fi access points. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of CGI scripts. When parsing the errorpage request parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-11856.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 这个漏洞允许网络攻击者在受影响的D-Link DAP-2020 v1.01rc001 Wi-Fi访问点上披露敏感信息。利用这个漏洞不需要身份验证。具体漏洞存在于CGI脚本的处理中。在解析errorpage请求参数时，该过程在使用用户提供的路径之前未正确验证。攻击者可以利用这个漏洞披露存储的凭据，导致进一步的威胁。该漏洞编号为ZDI-CAN-11856。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of D-Link DAP-2020 v1.01rc001 Wi-Fi access points. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of CGI scripts. When parsing the errorpage request parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-11856."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DAP系列产品存在 Null Pointer Dereference 漏洞
RECORDS.description_main: Null Pointer Dereference vulnerability exists in D-Link DAP-2310 2.07.RC031, DAP-2330 1.07.RC028, DAP-2360 2.07.RC043, DAP-2553 3.06.RC027, DAP-2660 1.13.RC074, DAP-2690 3.16.RC100, DAP-2695 1.17.RC063, DAP-3320 1.01.RC014 and DAP-3662 1.01.RC022 in the upload_certificate function of sbin/httpd binary. RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Null Pointer Dereference vulnerability exists in D-Link DAP-2310 2.07.RC031, DAP-2330 1.07.RC028, DAP-2360 2.07.RC043, DAP-2553 3.06.RC027, DAP-2660 1.13.RC074, DAP-2690 3.16.RC100, DAP-2695 1.17.RC063, DAP-3320 1.01.RC014 and DAP-3662 1.01.RC022 in the upload_certificate function of sbin/httpd binary. When the binary handle the specific HTTP GET request, the strrchr in the upload_certificate function would take NULL as first argument, and incur the NULL pointer dereference vulnerability."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link设备upload_config函数存在零指针漏洞
RECORDS.solution: D-Link已发布了固件更新，这些固件修复了漏洞。建议用户尽快升级设备的固件，并确保按照最佳安全实践保护其网络。

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Null Pointer Dereference vulnerability exists in D-Link DAP-2310 2.07.RC031, DAP-2330 1.07.RC028, DAP-2360 2.07.RC043, DAP-2553 3.06.RC027, DAP-2660 1.13.RC074, DAP-2690 3.16.RC100, DAP-2695 1.17.RC063, DAP-3320 1.01.RC014 and DAP-3662 1.01.RC022 in the upload_config function of sbin/httpd binary. RECORDS.description_main: D-Link DIR-2640-US 1.01B04 is vulnerable to Incorrect Access Control. Router ac2600 (dir-2640-us), when setting PPPoE, will start quagga process in the way of whole network monitoring, and this function uses the original default password and port. An attacker can easily use telnet to log in, modify routing information, monitor the traffic of all devices under the router, hijack DNS and phishing attacks. In addition, this interface is likely to be questioned by customers as a backdoor, because the interface should not be exposed.

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DAP-1330 路由器存在执行任意代码漏洞
RECORDS.solution: D-Link 公司已针对此漏洞发布了修复程序，并建议所有用户尽快进行更新，以提高网络安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1330 1.13B01 BETA routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the SOAPAction HTTP header. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-12029.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许相邻网络攻击者在受影响的 D-Link DAP-1330 1.13B01 BETA 路由器上执行任意代码。攻击者无需认证即可利用此漏洞。具体缺陷存在于处理 SOAPAction HTTP 头时。问题在于在将长度不足的用户提供的数据复制到基于固定长度的堆栈缓冲区之前缺乏适当的验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在设备上执行代码。漏洞编号 ZDI-CAN-12029。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1330 1.13B01 BETA routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the SOAPAction HTTP header. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-12029."}]}

RECORDS.solution: D-Link 推出了固件升级版本 1.01rc002，修复了此漏洞。建议用户立即升级其 D-Link DAP-2020 路由器的固件版本。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of D-Link DAP-2020 1.01rc001 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the getpage parameter provided to the webproc endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-12103.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞允许网络邻近攻击者在受影响的 D-Link DAP-2020 1.01rc001 路由器上泄露敏感信息。不需要验证即可利用此漏洞。特定漏洞存在于提供给 webproc 端点的 getpage 参数处理过程中。该问题的原因在于在使用文件操作之前未对用户提供的路径进行适当验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在 root 上下文中泄露信息。此漏洞编号为 ZDI-CAN-12103。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of D-Link DAP-2020 1.01rc001 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of the getpage parameter provided to the webproc endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-12103."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DAP-2020 1.01rc001路由器存在代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: D-Link已发布了修补程序来解决此问题。建议用户尽快更新到最新版本。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-2020 1.01rc001 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the webproc endpoint, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link、Edimax、NETGEAR、TP-Link、Tenda 和 Western Digital 设备存在整数溢出漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已经发布了针对此漏洞的补丁，建议及时更新固件以保证设备的安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: Certain D-Link, Edimax, NETGEAR, TP-Link, Tenda, and Western Digital devices are affected by an integer overflow by an unauthenticated attacker. Remote code execution from the WAN interface (TCP port 20005) cannot be ruled out; however, exploitability was judged to be of "rather significant complexity" but not "impossible." The overflow is in SoftwareBus_dispatchNormalEPMsgOut in the KCodes NetUSB kernel module. Affected NETGEAR devices are D7800 before 1.0.1.68, R6400v2 before 1.0.4.122, and R6700v3 before 1.0.4.122.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 未经身份验证的攻击者可利用整数溢出漏洞影响上述厂商的设备，存在远程代码执行风险（通过 WAN 接口的 TCP 端口 20005）。但是，攻击复杂度较高，且未被认为是不可能被攻击的。该漏洞出现在 KCodes NetUSB 内核模块的 SoftwareBus_dispatchNormalEPMsgOut 中。另外，NETGEAR 的 D7800（1.0.1.68 以前）、R6400v2（1.0.4.122 以前）和 R6700v3（1.0.4.122 以前）也会受到影响。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Certain D-Link, Edimax, NETGEAR, TP-Link, Tenda, and Western Digital devices are affected by an integer overflow by an unauthenticated attacker. Remote code execution from the WAN interface (TCP port 20005) cannot be ruled out; however, exploitability was judged to be of \"rather significant complexity\" but not \"impossible.\" The overflow is in SoftwareBus_dispatchNormalEPMsgOut in the KCodes NetUSB kernel module. Affected NETGEAR devices are D7800 before 1.0.1.68, R6400v2 before 1.0.4.122, and R6700v3 before 1.0.4.122."}]}

RECORDS.solution: D-Link已经发布了修复软件更新，建议尽快升级。此外，建议管理员在路由器中禁用远程管理功能，以最大程度地降低攻击风险。
RECORDS.description_main: A Remote Command Execution (RCE) vulnerability exists in HNAP1/control/SetNetworkTomographySettings.php of D-Link Router DIR-846 DIR846A1_FW100A43.bin and DIR846enFW100A53DLA-Retail.bin because backticks can be used for command injection when judging whether it is a reasonable domain name.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link路由器DIR-846 DIR846A1_FW100A43.bin和DIR846enFW100A53DLA-Retail.bin中的HNAP1/control/SetNetworkTomographySettings.php存在远程命令执行（RCE）漏洞，因为反引号可以用于命令注入，以判断是否为合理的域名。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A Remote Command Execution (RCE) vulnerability exists in HNAP1/control/SetNetworkTomographySettings.php of D-Link Router DIR-846 DIR846A1_FW100A43.bin and DIR846enFW100A53DLA-Retail.bin because backticks can be used for command injection when judging whether it is a reasonable domain name."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link路由器DIR-846 RCE漏洞存在且CVE-2019-17510未被修复
RECORDS.solution: 厂商建议用户及时更新到最新固件版本，关闭端口23 Telnet服务，并限制远程管理。
RECORDS.description_main: Remote Command Execution (RCE) vulnerability exists in HNAP1/control/SetWizardConfig.php in D-Link Router DIR-846 DIR846A1_FW100A43.bin and DIR846enFW100A53DLA-Retail.bin. Malicoius users can use this vulnerability to use "\ " or backticks in the shell metacharacters in the ssid0 or ssid1 parameters to cause arbitrary command execution. Since CVE-2019-17510 vulnerability has not been patched and improved www/hnap1/control/setwizardconfig.php, can also use line breaks and backquotes to bypass.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link路由器DIR-846 DIR846A1_FW100A43.bin和DIR846enFW100A53DLA-Retail.bin中的HNAP1 / control / SetWizardConfig.php存在远程命令执行（RCE）漏洞。恶意用户可以利用该漏洞在ssid0或ssid1参数中使用"\ "或反引号作为shell元字符，以导致任意命令执行。由于CVE-2019-17510漏洞尚未得到修复并改进了www / hnap1 / control / setwizardconfig.php，因此也可以使用换行符和反引号进行绕过。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Remote Command Execution (RCE) vulnerability exists in HNAP1/control/SetWizardConfig.php in D-Link Router DIR-846 DIR846A1_FW100A43.bin and DIR846enFW100A53DLA-Retail.bin. Malicoius users can use this vulnerability to use \"\\ \" or backticks in the shell metacharacters in the ssid0 or ssid1 parameters to cause arbitrary command execution. Since CVE-2019-17510 vulnerability has not been patched and improved www/hnap1/control/setwizardconfig.php, can also use line breaks and backquotes to bypass."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability exists in D-Link Router DIR-846 DIR846A1_FW100A43.bin and DIR846enFW100A53DLA-Retail.bin. Malicious users can use this vulnerability to use "\ " or backticks to bypass the shell metacharacters in the ssid0 or ssid1 parameters to execute arbitrary commands.This vulnerability is due to the fact that CVE-2019-17509 is not fully patched and can be bypassed by using line breaks or backticks on its basis.

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerability exists in D-Link Router DIR-846 DIR846A1_FW100A43.bin and DIR846enFW100A53DLA-Retail.bin. Malicious users can use this vulnerability to use \"\\ \" or backticks to bypass the shell metacharacters in the ssid0 or ssid1 parameters to execute arbitrary commands.This vulnerability is due to the fact that CVE-2019-17509 is not fully patched and can be bypassed by using line breaks or backticks on its basis."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DAP-1620中的路径遍历导致本地文件包含，从而导致未经授权的内部文件读取[ /etc/passwd ]和[ /etc/shadow ]。
RECORDS.solution: D-Link已经发布了新版本的固件来修复这个漏洞。用户应该立即下载和安装最新的固件版本，并确保设备上的所有设置都是最新的。此外，用户还应该使用复杂的密钥来保护他们的帐户，并经常更改这些密钥。他们应该避免使用默认的帐户和密码，并确保使用强密码来保护他们的设备。最后，他们应该密切关注他们的设备，并在发现任何异常情况时立即通知厂家。
RECORDS.description_main: Local File Inclusion due to path traversal in D-Link DAP-1620 leads to unauthorized internal files reading [/etc/passwd] and [/etc/shadow].
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 本漏洞是由于D-Link DAP-1620中的路径遍历不当引起的，攻击者可以利用此漏洞来读取未经授权的内部文件，包括/etc/passwd和/etc/shadow文件。这些文件包含敏感信息，如用户名、密码等。攻击者可以利用这些信息获取系统的控制权并对其进行进一步的攻击。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"Local File Inclusion due to path traversal in D-Link DAP-1620 leads to unauthorized internal files reading [/etc/passwd] and [/etc/shadow]."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DAP-1860 1.04B03_HOTFIX WiFi extender存在远程代码执行漏洞

The specific flaw exists within the HNAP service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. When parsing the SOAPAction header, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-10084.

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1860 1.04B03_HOTFIX WiFi extenders. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the HNAP service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. When parsing the SOAPAction header, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-10084."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DAP-1520设备存在安全漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 修复方案是升级到D-Link DAP-1520设备的1.10b04Beta02版本或更高版本。
RECORDS.description_main: An issue was discovered in apply.cgi on D-Link DAP-1520 devices before 1.10b04Beta02. Whenever a user performs a login action from the web interface, the request values are being forwarded to the ssi binary. On the login page, the web interface restricts the password input field to a fixed length of 15 characters. The problem is that validation is being done on the client side, hence it can be bypassed. When an attacker manages to intercept the login request (POST based) and tampers with the vulnerable parameter (log_pass), to a larger length, the request will be forwarded to the webserver. This results in a stack-based buffer overflow. A few other POST variables, (transferred as part of the login request) are also vulnerable: html_response_page and log_user.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在D-Link DAP-1520设备的1.10b04Beta02版本之前的apply.cgi中发现了一个安全漏洞。当用户从Web界面执行登录操作时，请求值将被转发到ssi二进制文件。在登录页面上，Web界面将密码输入字段限制为固定长度的15个字符。问题在于，客户端验证正在执行，因此可以绕过。当攻击者成功拦截登录请求（基于POST）并篡改易受攻击的参数（log_pass）以增加长度时，请求将被转发到Web服务器。这导致了栈基缓冲区溢出。其他几个POST变量（作为登录请求的一部分进行传输）也易受攻击：html_response_page和log_user。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An issue was discovered in apply.cgi on D-Link DAP-1520 devices before 1.10b04Beta02. Whenever a user performs a login action from the web interface, the request values are being forwarded to the ssi binary. On the login page, the web interface restricts the password input field to a fixed length of 15 characters. The problem is that validation is being done on the client side, hence it can be bypassed. When an attacker manages to intercept the login request (POST based) and tampers with the vulnerable parameter (log_pass), to a larger length, the request will be forwarded to the webserver. This results in a stack-based buffer overflow. A few other POST variables, (transferred as part of the login request) are also vulnerable: html_response_page and log_user."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-816L设备存在漏洞，2.x版本在1.10b04Beta02之前

Universal Plug and Play (UPnP) is enabled by default on port 1900. RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-816L 设备存在安全漏洞

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An issue was discovered on D-Link DIR-816L devices 2.x before 1.10b04Beta02. There exists an exposed administration function in getcfg.php, which can be used to call various services. It can be utilized by an attacker to retrieve various sensitive information, such as admin login credentials, by setting the value of _POST_SERVICES in the query string to DEVICE.ACCOUNT."}]}

RECORDS.description_main: An XSS issue was discovered on D-Link DIR-816L devices 2.x before 1.10b04Beta02. In the file webinc/js/info.php, no output filtration is applied to the RESULT parameter, before it's printed on the webpage.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 在文件webinc/js/info.php中，未对RESULT参数进行输出过滤，导致其在网页上输出时存在XSS漏洞。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An XSS issue was discovered on D-Link DIR-816L devices 2.x before 1.10b04Beta02. In the file webinc/js/info.php, no output filtration is applied to the RESULT parameter, before it's printed on the webpage."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DAP-1522设备1.4x至1.10b04Beta02版本存在身份验证绕过问题
RECORDS.solution: 厂商已发布补丁程序，建议受影响用户及时进行升级。在升级前应备份现有的配置文件，以避免数据丢失。同时，不建议开放影响该漏洞的端口，并限制相关访问权限，提高系统安全性。
RECORDS.description_main: An authentication-bypass issue was discovered on D-Link DAP-1522 devices 1.4x before 1.10b04Beta02. There exist a few pages that are directly accessible by any unauthorized user, e.g., logout.php and login.php. This occurs because of checking the value of NO_NEED_AUTH. If the value of NO_NEED_AUTH is 1, the user has direct access to the webpage without any authentication. By appending a query string NO_NEED_AUTH with the value of 1 to any protected URL, any unauthorized user can access the application directly, as demonstrated by bsc_lan.php?NO_NEED_AUTH=1.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 发现了D-Link DAP-1522设备1.4x至1.10b04Beta02版本存在身份验证绕过问题。存在几个页直接可被未经授权的用户访问，例如logout.php和login.php。这是由于NO_NEED_AUTH值的检查导致的。如果NO_NEED_AUTH值为1，则用户可以直接访问网页，而不需要任何身份验证。通过将NO_NEED_AUTH查询字符串追加到任何受保护的URL中，并赋予其值为1，任何未经授权的用户都可以直接访问应用程序，例如bsc_lan.php?NO_NEED_AUTH=1。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An authentication-bypass issue was discovered on D-Link DAP-1522 devices 1.4x before 1.10b04Beta02. There exist a few pages that are directly accessible by any unauthorized user, e.g., logout.php and login.php. This occurs because of checking the value of NO_NEED_AUTH. If the value of NO_NEED_AUTH is 1, the user has direct access to the webpage without any authentication. By appending a query string NO_NEED_AUTH with the value of 1 to any protected URL, any unauthorized user can access the application directly, as demonstrated by bsc_lan.php?NO_NEED_AUTH=1."}]}

RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link 公司的 DSR-250 (3.14) 和 DSR-1000N (2.11B201) 产品中的 UPnP 服务存在命令注入漏洞，攻击者可利用该漏洞进行远程命令执行。

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-619L 2.06beta mini_upnpd 堆缓冲区溢出漏洞

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-846 固件版本100A35 具有漏洞允许攻击者通过 HNAP1/control/SetGuestWLanSettings.php 执行任意代码。

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-823G REVA1 1.02B05 的 /cgi-bin/upload_firmware.cgi 组件存在问题，允许攻击者通过未指定的向量造成拒绝服务（DoS）攻击。
RECORDS.solution: D-Link 已发布了修复该漏洞的更新。建议用户尽快更新到最新版本以修复该问题。

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An issue in the component /cgi-bin/upload_firmware.cgi of D-Link DIR-823G REVA1 1.02B05 allows attackers to cause a denial of service (DoS) via unspecified vectors."}]}

RECORDS.solution: 用户应立即更新至最新版本的固件。同时，避免使用弱密码以及限制外部访问和开放服务的数量，可以降低被攻击的风险。

An attacker is able to execute arbitrary web scripts via shell metacharacters in the Captcha field to Login."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DIR-823G设备固件V1.0.2B05中的HNAP1协议存在命令注入漏洞
RECORDS.solution: D-Link已经发布了固件版本V1.0.2B06的补丁程序来修复该漏洞，建议受影响的用户尽快升级设备的固件版本。

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DSR VPN 路由器中 Lua CGI 缺少输入验证和访问控制可能导致任意命令执行
RECORDS.solution: D-Link 已针对此漏洞发布了更新的固件版本，建议受影响用户尽快更新到最新的固件版本。同时，建议限制对路由器的访问权限，并尽可能避免使用默认的管理员帐户。

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A lack of input validation and access controls in Lua CGIs on D-Link DSR VPN routers may result in arbitrary input being passed to system command APIs, resulting in arbitrary command execution with root privileges. This affects DSR-150, DSR-250, DSR-500, and DSR-1000AC with firmware 3.14 and 3.17."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DSR-250 3.17设备发现问题

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"An issue was discovered on D-Link DSR-250 3.17 devices. Insufficient validation of configuration file checksums could allow a remote, authenticated attacker to inject arbitrary crontab entries into saved configurations before uploading. RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DVA-2800和DSL-2888A路由器存在任意代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: D-Link已发布了更新版本的路由器固件，用户应该立即更新其固件以消除此漏洞的威胁。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DVA-2800 and DSL-2888A routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the dhttpd service, which listens on TCP port 8008 by default. When parsing the path parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the web server. Was ZDI-CAN-10911.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 此漏洞允许临近网络的攻击者在受影响的D-Link DVA-2800和DSL-2888A路由器上执行任意代码。攻击者无需进行身份验证即可利用此漏洞。具体漏洞存在于dhttpd服务中，默认情况下侦听TCP端口8008。在解析路径参数时，该进程在使用用户提供的字符串执行系统调用之前不正确地验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在Web服务器上下文中执行代码。漏洞编号为ZDI-CAN-10911。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DVA-2800 and DSL-2888A routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the dhttpd service, which listens on TCP port 8008 by default. When parsing the path parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the web server. Was ZDI-CAN-10911."}]}

RECORDS.solution: 建议安装最新的D-Link路由器固件，以修复此漏洞。

Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the dhttpd service, which listens on TCP port 8008 by default. The issue results from incorrect string matching logic when accessing protected pages. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-10912.

RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of D-Link DVA-2800 and DSL-2888A routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the dhttpd service, which listens on TCP port 8008 by default. The issue results from incorrect string matching logic when accessing protected pages. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose stored credentials, leading to further compromise. Was ZDI-CAN-10912."}]}

RECORDS.title_zh: D-Link DAP-1860 WiFi扩展器存在任意代码执行漏洞
RECORDS.solution: 官方已经发布补丁程序，请及时更新设备固件版本。
RECORDS.description_main: This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1860 firmware version 1.04B03 WiFi extenders. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the HNAP service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. When parsing the Authorization request header, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-10880.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: 该漏洞可使得网络相邻的攻击者在受影响的D-Link DAP-1860 固件版本为 1.04B03 的WiFi扩展器上执行任意代码。攻击者无需身份验证即可利用此漏洞。漏洞特定的在于HNAP服务，该服务默认监听TCP端口80。在解析授权请求头时，该过程在使用用户提供的字符串执行系统调用之前未能正确验证。攻击者可以利用此漏洞在设备上执行代码。该漏洞编号为ZDI-CAN-10880。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1860 firmware version 1.04B03 WiFi extenders. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the HNAP service, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. When parsing the Authorization request header, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of the device. Was ZDI-CAN-10880."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
D-Link DAP-1360 webproc var:menu Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1360 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling requests to the /cgi-bin/webproc endpoint. When parsing the var:menu parameter, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-18414.

D-Link DAP-1360 webproc WEB_DisplayPage Directory Traversal Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1360 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of requests to the /cgi-bin/webproc endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-18415.

D-Link DAP-1360 Hardcoded Credentials Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1360 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the processing of login requests to the web-based user interface. The firmware contains hard-coded default credentials. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
. Was ZDI-CAN-18455.

When parsing the errorpage and nextpage parameters, the process does not properly validate the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. . Was ZDI-CAN-18746.

D-Link DIR-2640 LocalIPAddress Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DIR-2640 routers. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of the LocalIPAddress parameter provided to the HNAP1 endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19544.

D-Link DIR-2640 HNAP PrivateLogin Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of D-Link DIR-2640 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the web management interface, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. A crafted XML element in the login request can cause authentication to succeed without providing proper credentials. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19545.

RECORDS.description_main:
D-Link D-View uploadMib Directory Traversal Arbitrary File Creation or Deletion Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create and delete arbitrary files on affected installations of D-Link D-View. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the uploadMib function. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied path prior to using it in file operations. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create or delete files in the context of SYSTEM.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19529.

D-Link D-View showUser Improper Authorization Privilege Escalation Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of D-Link D-View. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the showUser method. The issue results from the lack of proper authorization before accessing a privileged endpoint. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges to resources normally protected from the user.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19534.

D-Link D-View Use of Hard-coded Cryptographic Key Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of D-Link D-View. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the TokenUtils class. The issue results from a hard-coded cryptographic key. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system.
. Was ZDI-CAN-19659.

RECORDS.description_main:
D-Link DIR-2150 HNAP Incorrect Implementation of Authentication Algorithm Authentication Bypass Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to bypass authentication on affected installations of D-Link DIR-2150 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the SOAP API interface, which listens on TCP port 80 by default. A crafted authentication header can cause authentication to succeed without providing proper credentials. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to bypass authentication on the system. Was ZDI-CAN-20910.

RECORDS.description_main:
D-Link DAP-2622 DDP Change ID Password Auth Password Stack-based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-2622 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the DDP service. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of the length of user-supplied data prior to copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root.
. Was ZDI-CAN-20061.

D-Link DIR-X3260 prog.cgi SOAPAction Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DIR-X3260 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of the SOAPAction request header provided to the prog.cgi endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-20983.

RECORDS.description_main:
D-Link DAP-1325 HNAP SetWLanRadioSettings Channel Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DAP-1325 routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the handling of a request parameter provided to the HNAP1 SOAP endpoint. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-18822.

RECORDS.description_main:
D-Link D-View addDv7Probe XML External Entity Processing Information Disclosure Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of D-Link D-View. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the addDv7Probe function. Due to the improper restriction of XML External Entity (XXE) references, a crafted document specifying a URI causes the XML parser to access the URI and embed the contents back into the XML document for further processing. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to disclose information in the context of SYSTEM. Was ZDI-CAN-19571.

RECORDS.description_main: A command injection in the parsing_xml_stasurvey function inside libcgifunc.so of the D-Link DAP-X1860 repeater 1.00 through 1.01b05-01 allows attackers (within range of the repeater) to run shell commands as root during the setup process of the repeater, via a crafted SSID. Also, network names containing single quotes (in the range of the repeater) can result in a denial of service.
RECORDS.description_main_zh: D-Link DAP-X1860中继器1.00至1.01b05-01版本中的libcgifunc.so库中的parsing_xml_stasurvey函数存在命令注入漏洞。攻击者（在中继器范围内）可以在中继器设置过程中通过构造的SSID运行以root权限的shell命令。此外，包含单引号的中继器范围内的网络名称可能导致拒绝服务。
RECORDS.descriptions: {"description_data":[{"lang":"en","value":"A command injection in the parsing_xml_stasurvey function inside libcgifunc.so of the D-Link DAP-X1860 repeater 1.00 through 1.01b05-01 allows attackers (within range of the repeater) to run shell commands as root during the setup process of the repeater, via a crafted SSID. Also, network names containing single quotes (in the range of the repeater) can result in a denial of service."}]}

RECORDS.description_main:
D-Link G416 cfgsave Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link G416 wireless routers. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the HTTP service listening on TCP port 80. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-21286.

RECORDS.solution: 此漏洞仅影响那些不再受到维护者支持的产品。维护者已经确认该产品已停止使用，应予以退役和更换。
RECORDS.description_main: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, has been found in D-Link DAR-7000 up to 20151231. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /log/webmailattach.php. The manipulation of the argument table_name leads to an unknown weakness. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The associated identifier of this vulnerability is VDB-240239. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. NOTE: Vendor was contacted early and confirmed immediately that the product is end-of-life. It should be retired and replaced.

RECORDS.description_main: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** A vulnerability, which was classified as critical, was found in D-Link DAR-7000 and DAR-8000 up to 20151231. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The identifier of this vulnerability is VDB-240240. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. NOTE: Vendor was contacted early and confirmed that the product is end-of-life. It should be retired and replaced.

RECORDS.description_main: ** UNSUPPORTED WHEN ASSIGNED ** A vulnerability classified as critical was found in D-Link DAR-8000 up to 20151231. Affected by this vulnerability is an unknown functionality of the file /autheditpwd.php. The manipulation of the argument hid_id leads to sql injection. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been disclosed to the public and may be used. The associated identifier of this vulnerability is VDB-240247. NOTE: This vulnerability only affects products that are no longer supported by the maintainer. NOTE: Vendor was contacted early and confirmed immediately that the product is end-of-life. It should be retired and replaced.

RECORDS.description_main:
D-Link DIR-X3260 prog.cgi SetDynamicDNSSettings Stack-Based Buffer Overflow Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DIR-X3260 routers. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability.

The specific flaw exists within the prog.cgi binary, which handles HNAP requests made to the lighttpd webserver listening on TCP ports 80 and 443. The issue results from the lack of proper validation of a user-supplied string before copying it to a fixed-length stack-based buffer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-21590.

This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DCS-8300LHV2 IP cameras. RECORDS.description_main:
D-Link DCS-8300LHV2 ONVIF SetSystemDateAndTime Command Injection Remote Code Execution Vulnerability. This vulnerability allows network-adjacent attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of D-Link DCS-8300LHV2 IP cameras. Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be bypassed.

The specific flaw exists within the implementation of the ONVIF API, which listens on TCP port 80. When parsing the sch:TZ XML element, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to execute a system call. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of root. Was ZDI-CAN-21319.

RECORDS.description_main: A path traversal vulnerability exists in the web management interface of D-Link DSL-2730U, DSL-2750U, and DSL-2750E ADSL routers with firmware versions IN_1.02, SEA_1.04, and SEA_1.07. The vulnerability is due to insufficient input validation on the getpage parameter within the /cgi-bin/webproc CGI script. This flaw allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to perform path traversal attacks by supplying crafted requests, enabling arbitrary file read on the affected device.
